headline: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 workers
standfirst: The tech giant is cutting costs as it shifts its focus toward artificial intelligence.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyout packages to 60,000 of its employees.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The company wants to lower operating costs as it invests heavily in artificial intelligence.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It highlights how quickly AI adoption is forcing major tech firms to restructure their workforce.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Monitor whether other major tech companies follow this strategy to cut expenses.

caption:
Microsoft is reportedly offering buyouts to 60,000 employees as the company shifts focus to artificial intelligence.

This move highlights a broader trend in the tech industry. Companies are restructuring budgets to prioritize AI development. It remains to be seen how this impacts overall staffing levels.
